preview.mode.endpoints.comment: Mode label, shown in the mode control beside Source and Outline, for the table of operations in an OpenAPI or Swagger document (one row per method and path). Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.openapi.column.deprecated.comment: Column header of the Endpoints table. The cells in this column say Yes, using the same word as the Yes value, for an operation the document marks as deprecated, and are empty otherwise. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.

preview.openapi.unresolvedReferences.comment: Limits sentence under the Endpoints table: how many path items name a reference this preview cannot follow inside the document, so their operations are not listed. The first formatter argument selects the plural category and is never printed; the second is the count formatted for the presentation locale and every variant prints it as %2$@. Draft translations pending native-speaker review.
